display.title: Achdus: Mordechai's Secret to Jewish Survival
display.summary_short: Haman thought the Jews were weak because they were divided, but Mordechai knew the secret of Jewish survival: unity and Ahavas Yisroel.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show in the Purim season. Uncle Yossi explains what our Sages teach about Haman's words to Achashverosh, 'there is one nation, scattered and separate': Haman saw that the Jewish people lacked unity, and that weakness let him plan his harsh decrees. Mordechai the tzaddik knew the secret of Jewish survival: achdus, togetherness, and above all Ahavas Yisroel, loving one another and showing it by helping one another in every way. Uncle Yossi calls this the order of the day, and of every day, for the soldiers of Tzivos Hashem.
display.lesson: The Jewish people stay strong through unity: love one another and help one another in every way.
